title: Implement automatic live-to-draft data synchronization

requirements.text: Add a backend function to export all Nakshatra data including text content (name, description, deity, symbol, characteristics, lunarClimate, karmicLesson, and all four pada descriptions) and return it as a serializable data structure

quotes: ALL data from live (all nakshatra text + all uploaded images)

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query function that returns complete Nakshatra data for all 27 entries
Exported data includes all text fields and references to associated image IDs
Function is callable by authenticated users with appropriate permissions

requirements.text: Add a backend function to export all uploaded image blobs with their associated Nakshatra IDs, returning image data and metadata in a format suitable for cross-canister transfer

quotes: ALL data from live (all nakshatra text + all uploaded images)

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query function that returns all stored image blobs with their IDs
Image data is returned in a format that can be imported into another canister
Function handles large image payloads efficiently

requirements.text: Add a backend import function that accepts Nakshatra data and replaces all existing Nakshatra entries, ensuring imported data completely overwrites current state

quotes: all data uploaded in the live app will be synced in future drafts

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an update function that accepts complete Nakshatra dataset
Import function completely replaces existing Nakshatra data with imported data
Live data always takes priority over any existing draft data
Function is restricted to authenticated admin users

requirements.text: Add a backend import function that accepts image data with IDs and stores all imported images, replacing any existing images with matching IDs

quotes: ALL data from live (all nakshatra text + all uploaded images)

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an update function that accepts image data with IDs
Import function stores all images and overwrites any existing images with the same ID
Function handles large image payloads efficiently
Function is restricted to authenticated admin users

requirements.text: Create a frontend admin utility that automatically fetches all data from the live canister and imports it into the draft canister when triggered, implementing the complete sync workflow

quotes: ALL data from live (all nakshatra text + all uploaded images)
all data uploaded in the live app will be synced in future drafts

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend implements logic to call live canister export functions
Frontend calls draft canister import functions with exported data
Sync process handles both Nakshatra text data and image blobs
Sync shows progress feedback to admin users
Error handling provides clear messages if sync fails

requirements.text: Add a 'Sync from Live' button in the admin panel that triggers the automatic data synchronization from live to draft, displaying sync progress and completion status

quotes: all data uploaded in the live app will be synced in future drafts

acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel includes a clearly labeled sync button
Button shows loading state during sync operation
Success message confirms when sync completes
Error messages display if sync fails with actionable guidance

requirements.text: Update the AdminPage to display sync status information showing when the last sync occurred and whether draft data is in sync with live data

quotes: all data uploaded in the live app will be synced in future drafts

acceptanceCriteria: Admin page shows timestamp of last successful sync
UI indicates if draft data differs from live data
Sync status updates automatically after sync operations complete

constraints: Do not modify the existing Nakshatra data structure in backend/main.mo
Live canister data must always take priority over draft data during sync
Sync operations must handle large image payloads without timeout errors
Export and import functions must preserve all Nakshatra fields including pada descriptions
nonGoals: Automatic sync on draft creation without admin trigger
